evidence.probe: Compare full history-backed state retention with a deterministic compact recipe by using former LATEST blob 2e3373ff9138b389697a0b0f5433b4356735b556 (r332) as the base and the pre-update current LATEST blob 6c7e64b015f65c5d69c0747015fa27dbc6ef273d (r333) as the target. A JSON Merge Patch-style recipe replaces only the 13 changed locations: logical_revision; authority.transport_mode; predecessor_latest_blob_sha; latest_checkpoint_path/blob/commit; latest_receipt_path/blob/commit; latest_evidence; frontier; exact_continuation; updated_at. All other parsed JSON fields are inherited from the base.
evidence.tested_scope: One own-role r332->r333 LATEST transition. Reconstruction claim is semantic parsed-JSON equality from the exact base blob plus the bounded replacement recipe, not byte-for-byte whitespace preservation. No public or cross-role semantic input, external compute, hosted runner, paid service, protected authority or manual user action was used.
